items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1959-10-26
items.q: No, I never knew him. I never met him.

ctx.x: A Jelly Roll Martin. Oh, yeah. It's on the record, where he says, you can hear him say, I like whiskey. Give me some more whiskey. This fellow invented him. This man never was recognized in his life. You mean Alan Lomax. Alan Lomax invented him.
Did you ever see Jelly Roll Martin?
